course.title: Diver Medic Training (DMT) - Complete Course
course.description: Comprehensive medical training program for Diver Medic Technicians (DMTs) and Medical First Aiders (MFAs). Covers accident management, medical emergencies, and essential medical procedures for diving operations.

modules.title: Accident Management Fundamentals
modules.description: Core principles of accident management including bleeding control, soft tissue injuries, and shock management

modules.title: Trauma and Injury Management
modules.description: Advanced trauma management covering fractures, crush injuries, and chest trauma

modules.title: Burns and Environmental Injuries
modules.description: Management of burns, electrical injuries, and poisoning incidents

modules.title: Patient Assessment
modules.description: Systematic approach to casualty assessment and triage

modules.title: Medical Emergency Response
modules.description: Management of medical emergencies in diving operations

modules.title: Vascular Access Procedures
modules.description: Cannulation techniques and vascular access procedures

modules.title: Airway Management
modules.description: Advanced airway management techniques and procedures

modules.title: Thoracic Procedures
modules.description: Chest drain insertion and thoracentesis procedures

modules.title: Surgical Procedures
modules.description: Basic suturing techniques and wound closure

modules.title: Pharmacology and Drug Administration
modules.description: Drug administration techniques and pharmacological principles

modules.title: Diving Medical Advisory Service (DMAS)
modules.description: DMAS protocols and procedures for diving medical support
